# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment documents generated for the Spring Music report. Use the links below to navigate to the detailed architecture, dependency, API, data, configuration, and workflow analyses.

- [architecture-diagram.md](architecture-diagram.md) - High-level application architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](dependency-map.md) - Declared dependency inventory grouped by functional category.
- [api-service-contracts.md](api-service-contracts.md) - Service catalog, endpoint inventory, communication patterns, and request flow sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](data-architecture.md) - Persistence profile summary, entity model, repository methods, and data ownership notes.
- [configuration-inventory.md](configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, profiles, properties, startup settings, and secrets workflow.
- [business-workflows.md](business-workflows.md) - Business domain summary, primary workflows, and business rule documentation.
